result.summary: The layout is mostly intact. The one clear defect is a nonsensical '−100%' promo badge on the second 'Popular right now' card. Clipped carousel and chip items at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom are intended and not reported.

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' (the pizza restaurant) shows a '−100%' badge. A 100% discount implies everything is free, which is almost certainly a mis-rendered or miscalculated value. It is also inconsistent with the '€0 delivery' badge style used on the Tokumaru card above, so it misleads users about pricing.
issues.suggestion: Fix the discount value or formatting logic so the badge shows the real offer (e.g., '−20%' or '€0 delivery'). Add validation to hide or clamp promo badges with implausible values such as 100% off.
